normalizedObservations.limitation: Exact-source metadata supports technique themes but not reliable numeric stages; no numeric values are inferred.

safetyConstraints.measurementRule: Measure the thickest edible portion with a food thermometer; avoid bone. For whole poultry, verify the innermost thigh and wing and the thickest breast.
safetyConstraints.sourceEndpointConflictPolicy: Any practitioner endpoint below 165F is non-portable as safety guidance and is overridden by the USDA/FSIS minimum.

heat_source_fuel.decisionNote: Fuel is a flavor and heat-management choice; the source set does not support one mandatory fuel.

direct_vs_indirect_heat.decisionNote: Preserve direct and indirect branches instead of averaging them into one method.

heat_intensity.decisionNote: Detailed sources cluster at 275F, with a documented 300F competition-thigh branch.

time_endpoint.decisionNote: Do not average endpoint temperatures; safety and desired texture are separate controls.

brine_salt_level_duration.decisionNote: Sources use different brine/injection systems, so no universal salt concentration is inferred.

marinade_duration.decisionNote: Keep marinade duration optional rather than translating brine/injection evidence into a false universal marinade rule.

sweetness.commonPattern: Sweet components are concentrated in late glaze or sauce stages rather than treated as a required base seasoning.
sweetness.decisionNote: Expose sweetness as a user-controlled finish variable.

acidity.decisionNote: The qualified set does not support a mandatory acid level.

spice_heat.commonPattern: Heat can enter through rub layers or finishing sauce without changing the core cook sequence.

smoke_intensity.decisionNote: Smoke level should vary with cut size and desired style; no single intensity is universal.

glaze_sauce_timing.decisionNote: Late glazing is the most consistent cross-source pattern and reduces prolonged sugar exposure.

resting_finishing.decisionNote: Holding and resting depend on service context; competition holding is not required for home service.
